issue_context.title: Activity ParentId Does Not Format flags
issue_context.body:
### Description
When using the SetParentId overload that takes in the individual traceId, spanId and flags the ActivityTraceFlags get set correctly. However when calling the lazy ParentId getter the format is hard coded to return no flags ("-00"). Why is this format logic ignoring the ActivityTraceFlags when the Id getter does do the correct formatting? 

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/970d347a1b06951692cfecc1cc12a500158708b1/src/libraries/System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource/src/System/Diagnostics/Activity.cs#L539

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/970d347a1b06951692cfecc1cc12a500158708b1/src/libraries/System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource/src/System/Diagnostics/Activity.cs#L223

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/970d347a1b06951692cfecc1cc12a500158708b1/src/libraries/System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource/src/System/Diagnostics/Activity.cs#L197
